brief: Reads one JSON Web Token: its header, its claims and its signature, and checks the signature against a public key.
detail: Use it on its own for any signed token with three parts. Reading a claim proves nothing: the token is only data until SignatureIsValidWith has passed against a key you hold, and a token meant for you must also carry your audience and an unexpired exp, which stzOidcClient checks. A malformed token is accepted at construction and simply reads as empty.
